facts.text: Serve the mains when Goofy and Max finally make camp by Lake Destiny.
facts.why: They never reach Lake Destiny. They camp on the way, run into Pete and P.J., and Max redraws the route to Los Angeles. Goofy only says it is a couple of days away.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Goofy and Max run into Pete and P.J. at the campsite.

facts.text: Max and Roxanne at the big concert in LA
facts.why: Roxanne is not at the concert. She watches it on TV at a party at home, while Max and Goofy end up on stage.
facts.fix: Max and Goofy on stage at the big Powerline concert in LA

facts.text: Final night of the world tour
facts.why: The sources say Powerline plays a live concert in Los Angeles. None of them call it the final night of a world tour.
The map names Spoonerville as home. Neither source I opened names the town.
facts.fix: Home sweet home, the start of the road trip

vibe.verdict: Bright placemat with a road map and the possum park, but the cue and one note get the road trip wrong.
